composition_label: basic:support -> interests -> web; Energy and utilities

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written for this build; no other build read or copied.

shared_schema.input_contract: synthetic=true, status=ok, stage=input; future outputs null; normalized meter_readings initially empty. Unknown fields and duplicate JSON keys rejected.

context.preferences: nonnegative tag weights 0..10, excluded IDs/tags, limit 0..20
context.knowledge_base: Unique IDs, title, text, tags and HTTPS provenance URL
context.catalog: Unique IDs, title, tags, nonempty valid knowledge IDs and HTTPS URL
context.sources: Exact canonical URL allowlist and synthetic offline document snapshots; source_sha256 initially null, populated with original snapshot digest before protection
context.energy: Smart-meter interval CSV plus normalized readings, synthetic grid assets/topology, SCADA-style telemetry JSON, outage reports, sourced emissions and immutable declared safety rules

shared_schema.validation: One shared validate function checks every incoming/outgoing stage, context types, finite numbers, relationships, safety priorities and exact deterministic stage outputs.
shared_schema.error_contract: CLI returns one JSON object with status=error and exit 2 for validation, JSON decoding, file, size and usage errors. Error messages never echo source values.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated context, normalized meter intervals and identifier-protected assets. Raw grid IDs are replaced throughout public context before support generation.
Validated support intent tags and matched knowledge IDs influence recommendation scores; the handoff records consumed knowledge IDs.
Validated selected recommendation IDs, research terms and grounding URLs strictly bound research scope. Excluded recommendations cannot create findings.

behavior.support: General-purpose token-based knowledge retrieval, verbatim cited excerpts, explicit unknown-answer fallback, offline async-ticket or online live-queue suggestion, safety escalation, meter totals and sourced emissions. No ticket is actually submitted.
behavior.interests: Score = sum of matching explicit preference weights + 2 per shared support intent tag + 1 per shared support knowledge ID. Positive-score candidates only; ID/tag exclusions always win; stable ID tie-break; explanations show contributions and source excerpts.
behavior.web: Supplied snapshots only, never live HTTP. Exact canonical HTTPS URL ingestion allowlist. Finds matching passages only for selected recommendations; preserves URL, title, protected quote/offset, SHA-256 of protected snapshot content and source_sha256 of the original snapshot. Missing, blocked and irrelevant URLs are reported separately.
behavior.asset_protection: NERC CIP-style demonstrative identifier minimization, not certification: every synthetic grid identifier is replaced by a stable per-input alias throughout all output strings and references. No mapping is returned. Identifier-bearing URLs are rejected, including percent-encoded identifiers. sha256 and quote offsets refer to protected content; source_sha256 identifies the original supplied content without exposing identifiers.

outage_rules.P1: life_safety or critical_service, regardless of affected customer count

behavior.emissions: Structured emissions require finite nonnegative values, kgCO2e/tCO2e/gCO2e-per-kWh units and a known knowledge-base source ID.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly synthetic fictitious substation/feeder topology, smart-meter half-hour intervals with plausible higher winter consumption, SCADA voltage/load/frequency points, outage scenarios and illustrative emissions.
behavior.determinism: No clock, randomness, network, model call, file mutation or provider dependency in the pipeline.

included: Shared schema and validation on all handoffs
Offline grounded support and preference ranking
Allowlisted offline snapshot research and traceable findings
Synthetic energy entity validation and public identifier protection
Standard-library unittest and subprocess CLI checks
excluded: Production deployment, authentication, encrypted storage and operational access controls
Live websites, crawling, HTTP redirects, providers and LLM inference
Actual outage dispatch, restoration predictions, ticket submission or grid control
NERC CIP or other regulatory certification
Fact verification beyond supplied evidence, free-text emissions extraction and real-world emissions accounting
